context: Tests that B.5 branches on customer.deployTarget == 'shared' upfront and skips the entire local-run phase (B.5-B.11): no tier menu, no credential collection, no auth-mode application, no boot attempt. A demo reuses the already-deployed, persistently-running shared environment, so a local run is never applicable, not just optional.

checklist.name: Does not present the local-run tier menu
checklist.description: The agent does not offer or describe the three-way tier choice (preview / local-no-login / local-login) or ask the customer to pick one.

checklist.name: Does not attempt any local-run setup
checklist.description: The agent does not ask for Content Hub credentials, does not modify auth.js, and does not try to boot the local dev server.

checklist.name: Recognizes shared environment is already live
checklist.description: The agent's stated reasoning/behavior shows it recognizes this is a demo on the already-deployed shared environment and that nothing needs to be set up locally - the change just needs to be merged.

checklist.name: Marks run-tier steps not-applicable, not left pending
checklist.description: The agent marks or clearly states it is marking tier-selected through boot-verified as not-requested/not-applicable and treats backend-onboarding as effectively done, rather than leaving them as unfinished pending steps.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No internal step ids, or the words shared/dedicated/deployTarget/scopeChoice, are shown to the customer.
